solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Sky pundit?

parts.note: read as a TV commentator on the Sky channel, but really an expert on what the sky's stars foretell

explanation.surface: A television commentator working for Sky Sports or Sky News.
explanation.walkthrough: Sky is a British broadcaster with many pundits; here the sky is the heavens, and the pundit reads the stars.
explanation.definitionFit: A stargazing forecaster who claims expertise about the heavens and their influence is literally a pundit of the sky.

clue.text: Showing sense eating Australian food

indicators.note: one word eating another takes it into its middle, so the first piece encloses the second

parts.note: sage means wise, showing good sense
Aus is the standard short form of Australian

explanation.surface: Someone sensibly tucking into Australian cuisine.
explanation.definitionFit: A banger of minced meat in a skin is an everyday food item.

clue.text: Relationship from a time in port

indicators.note: the letters for 'a time' sit in the middle of the port's name

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro, the Brazilian port, is often shortened to Rio

explanation.surface: Someone recounts a romance struck up during a stopover in a harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics a proportion between two quantities is their relationship expressed as a quotient.

clue.text: German aboard vessel he's reluctant to leave

indicators.note: a passenger aboard a ship is inside it, so the German goes within the vessel

parts.note: a liner is a large passenger ship

explanation.surface: A German passenger on a cruise ship who won't disembark.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who dawdles and stays on after others go is reluctant to leave.

clue.text: Seeing film from book, blown away

definitions.meaning: the 1939 film made from Margaret Mitchell's novel
literally carried off by a gust, vanished

explanation.surface: Someone watching a screen adaptation of a novel is thoroughly bowled over.
explanation.definitionFit: The title of the famous Civil War epic, both novel and movie, also literally describes something carried off by a breeze.

clue.text: Outcome affected Ulster

indicators.note: affected here means altered or acted upon, so the letters of the province's name are rearranged

explanation.surface: A report on how a decision or vote has affected Northern Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: Ulster is the northern Irish province, largely Northern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcome is the consequence or end product of an event, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Internet location — something worth viewing, it's said

indicators.note: it's said signals that a word spoken aloud gives the entry

parts.note: a sight is something worth seeing, as in seeing the sights

explanation.surface: A web page recommended as a must-see.
explanation.definitionFit: A web address with its pages is a place you visit on the internet.

clue.text: He helps gullible guy, we hear, with tips from elder

indicators.note: we hear signals that the gullible guy's word is spoken and a same-sounding word is used

parts.note: a sucker is a person easily fooled

indicators.note: the tips of a word are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A kindly helper advises a naive man, with guidance from an older person.
explanation.walkthrough: SUCCOUR (help) sounds like SUCKER; 'tips from' takes E and R from elder.
explanation.definitionFit: Succour means aid or relief, so one who gives it is a helper.

clue.text: Financial staff get new start in ships

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word is replaced by a different one, here the T

parts.note: bankers are staff working in finance

explanation.surface: Bank employees take up fresh careers at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get new start' swaps the B of BANKERS for T; the clue does not name the new letter, the ships do.
explanation.definitionFit: Tankers are vessels built to carry oil or other liquids in bulk.

clue.text: Expected tenor to give performance

parts.note: due means expected, as in a train due at noon
T is a standard abbreviation for tenor in music

explanation.surface: A tenor is scheduled to sing at a concert.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece performed by two musicians together is a kind of performance.

clue.text: Grandma, old, back for short time

parts.note: nan is a familiar name for a grandmother
to back a motion is to second it

explanation.surface: An elderly grandmother returns after a brief absence.
explanation.definitionFit: A billionth part of a second is an extremely brief interval.

clue.text: US gangster's headwear, unique

parts.note: a cap is a piece of headwear
one can mean unique, one of a kind

explanation.surface: An American mobster's hat is one of a kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Al, the Chicago mob boss of the Prohibition era, is the most famous American gangster.

clue.text: Rule withdrawn by King on recovery from crushing defeat

indicators.note: withdrawn here means drawn backwards, so the rule's word is reversed

parts.note: a law is a rule
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king
to be over an illness or setback is to have recovered from it

explanation.surface: A monarch rescinds a decree while bouncing back from a heavy loss.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-sided contest won with no real opposition is a rout, an utterly lopsided defeat for the loser.

clue.text: Corrupt period — precursor to later books

indicators.note: a precursor comes before, so the period goes ahead of the books

parts.note: a decade is a period of ten years
NT, the New Testament, comprises the later books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A morally rotten era came before the books that followed.
explanation.definitionFit: Decadent describes moral decline and self-indulgence, a sense of corrupt.

clue.text: Troubled teen beginning to regret past now

indicators.note: troubled means disturbed, so the letters are thrown into a new order
the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: An anxious adolescent starts to regret past deeds right now.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning to regret' gives R, joining TEEN and PAST as the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means currently, at this moment, so it equals now.

clue.text: Girl got up

definitions.meaning: past tense of rise, to stand up or ascend

explanation.surface: A young woman rose from her seat.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a female forename and also the past tense of the verb meaning stand or ascend.

clue.text: How loveless and lesser unfortunately, they fail to meet obligations

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things going wrong, so the letters are jumbled
loveless means the word loses its love, the zero-shaped letter from tennis scoring

explanation.surface: A wry question about how heartless, lesser people dodge their debts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loveless' strips O from HOW to leave HW, which with LESSER is shuffled.
explanation.definitionFit: A welsher, especially at the racecourse, is someone who evades paying debts or keeping promises.

clue.text: Spring leads to joy, universal, many proclaim

indicators.note: the leads of words are their opening letters, taken from each of the next four

explanation.surface: Many people declare that springtime brings happiness to all.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to spring is to leap or bound upward, the same as this word.

clue.text: Be fond of female initially as different

indicators.note: initially here places the woman's name at the beginning, before the verb

parts.note: Una is a female first name
to like someone is to be fond of them

explanation.surface: Someone grows fond of a woman, at first finding her different.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means not alike, dissimilar, which is to say different.

clue.text: One reasoning believer accepts indication of alternative

indicators.note: to accept is to take in, so the believer's word holds the other piece

parts.note: a theist believes in God
the word or signals an alternative

explanation.surface: A religious person entertains the idea of another option.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who builds and reasons through hypotheses or abstract ideas is a thinker of theory.

clue.text: Expensive — the French church feature

parts.note: steep means overpriced
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A costly French church tower.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall tower topped by a spire is a prominent feature of many churches.

clue.text: Minister won over tiddler

parts.note: Min is an abbreviation for minister or ministry

indicators.note: over here means turned over, so the word is read backwards

explanation.surface: A minister wins over a small child.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiddler is a very small fish, and a minnow is a common tiny freshwater fish.

clue.text: Murray's limit?

parts.note: Andy Murray is a British tennis champion; the boundary at the back of his court marks the limit of play

explanation.surface: Wondering how far a person called Murray can go.
explanation.walkthrough: Andy Murray is a Scottish former world number one at tennis; the court line at each end is where he mostly plays.
explanation.definitionFit: On a tennis court the back boundary line marks the limit of where a shot may land.

clue.text: Nurse is coming back — rest ordered

indicators.note: coming back means returning, so the two letters are read in reverse
ordered means arranged, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nurse returns to duty after being told to take a break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming back' turns IS into SI; 'ordered' rearranges REST as STER.
explanation.definitionFit: In British hospitals a senior nurse in charge of a ward is called by this title.

clue.text: Sun's rise over lake

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece over another can wrap around it, so the rising word covers the lake

parts.note: to soar is to rise high

explanation.surface: The sun comes up above a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means of or relating to the sun, matching the possessive.

clue.text: Road vehicle fee in Niger under review

indicators.note: being reviewed means being reworked, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A road toll in the West African country is being reconsidered.
explanation.definitionFit: A pump truck that carries firefighters is a vehicle driven on roads.

clue.text: Solo performance has run

indicators.note: has here means contains, so the letters sit inside the words before it

explanation.surface: A one-person show enjoys a long stint in the theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: To lope is to run with long, easy strides.

clue.text: Paper covers team's core achievement

indicators.note: covers means wraps around, so the paper's letters enclose the other piece

parts.note: FT is the Financial Times newspaper

indicators.note: the core of a word is its middle letters, here from team

explanation.surface: A newspaper reports a sports side's key accomplishment.
explanation.definitionFit: A feat is a notable accomplishment, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Somewhere to watch red wine (sec) in preparation

indicators.note: something in preparation is being made up, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A bottle of dry red is being got ready for an evening's viewing.
explanation.walkthrough: Sec is French for dry, used of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A wide cinema or television display is a place where one watches films.
